title: .ssot.yaml manifest
description: Single-source-of-truth manifest: one canonical location per fact plus every hand-copied instance. The ssot-check CLI re-implements these checks in stdlib (validate subcommand); this schema is for editors and CI YAML-linting.

ignore_paths.description: Glob patterns excluded from globbed copy expansion and from discover scans.

name.description: Short kebab-case identifier for the fact.

note.description: What the fact is, its update cadence, and counting conventions.

type.description: Normalization applied before comparison. Default string is literal (whitespace + trailing '+' only).

monotonic.description: If true and a copy is numerically higher than the canonical, drift is flagged 'canonical suspect' (a count that only grows means the higher value is probably fresher).

freshness.description: Flag the canonical file when its git last-edit date is older than max_age_days.

file.description: Forward-slash path relative to repo root. May escape the root (../sibling) for a cross-repo, read-only location.

pattern.description: Regex with exactly ONE capture group around the value.

file.description: Copy location. May be a glob (docs/*.md) for local paths.

pattern.description: Regex with exactly ONE capture group around the value.

rounding.description: Deterministic transform applied to the canonical value before exact comparison, for copies a script intentionally rounds.
